line: Bitcoin rebounds on liquidation cascade while spot ETFs post outflows and sentiment sits at extreme fear.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin +0.83% on the day, spot ETF net -669.2M USD (Nov 20, 2026), Fear & Greed 11 (extreme fear), funding +0.0004% per 8h (calm)

wire_top3.line: Bitcoin rebounded above $60K after $1.8 billion in leveraged crypto liquidations, mostly bullish positions closed in the selloff.
Cyber bridge exploit prompted Upbit and Bithumb to halt CYBER deposits and withdrawals; unexpected token minting on Solana followed by bridge lockbox outflows.
Chainflip disclosed theft of 122.9 BTC and other assets totaling $12M, offering a 10% bounty for return by Nov. 24.
